listing.name: Discord Rich Presence
listing.summary: Ever wanted to show your friends you're playing a single player game right now so they don't spam invites to shitty multiplayer games? Yeah, introducing discord rich presence, shows up on discord for everyone with a nice icon and all.
listing.aiSummary: Shows your current game state in Discord, including commander name, ship, location, fleet size, and credits.

description:
Discord Rich Presence

Ever wanted to show your friends you're playing a single player game right now so they don't spam invites to *** multiplayer games?

Yeah, introducing discord rich presence, shows up on discord for everyone with a nice icon and all. The information provided is taken from the game dynamically.

The code is fully open source under a license of "do whatever you want to do with it". You don't have to credit me, as claude code built this anyway.

Information Provided

Commander Details — Shows {yourplayername} and level {yourlevel}.Ship Info — Shows {flagship name} and ({flagship class}).Location — Displays {currentLocalization}.Fleet & Economy — Displays {ships In fleet amount} and {current credits}.

Data Format

[indent]cmdr {yourplayername} level {yourlevel} | {flagship name} ({flagship class}) {currentLocalization} - {ships In fleet amount } - {current credits}[/indent]

aiDescription: Displays real-time game information in Discord, such as your commander's name and level, flagship name and class, current location, number of ships in your fleet, and current credits. The data is pulled dynamically from the game and shown with a custom rich presence format.
